coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 3 figures

top_level.justification: Matches the authoritative roadmap and actual construct.

top_level.current_content: Almacén relacional del ER: fuentes, entidades, pares, decisiones append-only y evidencia — con constraints, consultas de cola y transacciones atómicas en SQLite de laboratorio
top_level.improved_content: Almacén relacional del ER con fuentes, entidades, candidatos, decisiones y evidencia enlazados por constraints; historia de decisiones/vínculos protegida, cola derivada del estado vigente y transacciones atómicas verificadas con pytest en SQLite de laboratorio.
top_level.justification: Current tagline promises append-only/evidence/queue integrity that the canonical schema and repository do not enforce.

top_level.current_content: El almacén de verdad del entity resolution guarda fuentes, entidades, pares, decisiones y evidencia con historia auditable. En equipos de datos (banca, telecom, retail en Perú y LatAm), un analista o ingeniero que modela PK/FK (claves primaria y foránea), temporalidad y consultas de cola de revisión en SQL reduce reprocesos y reemplaza discusiones sin evidencia por decisiones trazables. Aquí practicas con SQLite de laboratorio (constraints, joins, ACID, migraciones y repository) como contrato del motor antes de un almacén corporativo.
top_level.improved_content: El almacén de verdad de resolución de entidades debe permitir reconstruir qué fuente produjo cada candidato, qué versión de entidad se veía, qué decisión tomó una persona y qué evidencia la sustentó. En S29 lo modelas con claves/constraints y eventos históricos, consultas de cola sobre estado vigente, transacciones atómicas, migraciones reproducibles y un repository que conserva las mismas invariantes. SQLite permite demostrar gran parte del contrato local; lo específico de concurrencia/dialecto corporativo debe probarse después contra el motor real.
top_level.justification: Removes unsupported business-impact claims and names the evidence actually required.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Definir PK/FK/CHECK/UNIQUE en SQLite con PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON y demostrar violación con IntegrityError
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Definir y probar con pytest PK/FK/CHECK/NOT NULL/UNIQUE, habilitar y verificar foreign_keys por conexión, y cubrir explícitamente par duplicado, FK rota, dominio de score y política de coerción/tipo.
learning_outcomes.justification: Canonical DDL omits pair UNIQUE and does not test SQLite affinity behavior.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Modelar temporalidad y provenance (append-only de decisions; vínculo N–N fuente–entidad vía entity_source_links) sin sobrescribir historia
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Modelar eventos de decisión y vínculos fuente–entidad versionados con estado/vigencia, FKs y lineage resoluble, de modo que la ruta soportada no reescriba ni borre historia.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current model conflates candidacy/membership and append-only is unenforced.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Escribir CTEs, ROW_NUMBER y anti-joins seguros (NOT EXISTS / LEFT JOIN … IS NULL; no NOT IN con NULL) para colas de review
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Construir colas de review derivando primero el último estado pendiente, filtrar antes de rankear y usar ROW_NUMBER con desempate total; distinguir esa consulta de un anti-join literal sin ninguna decisión.
learning_outcomes.justification: Canonical top-N query can starve pending cases and any decision currently closes the pair.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Razonar cardinalidad de joins, NULL con IS NULL y planes con EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN (SCAN vs. SEARCH)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Estimar cardinalidad, aplicar la semántica SQL de NULL y leer el campo detail de EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN para el query concreto, distinguiendo SCAN/SEARCH e índice usado sin depender de un formato textual estable.
learning_outcomes.justification: Plan-row count and figure caption do not teach the advertised plan reasoning.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Garantizar atomicidad decisión+evidencia con BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK en la misma conexión
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Probar con pytest que decisión y evidencia de esa decisión comparten transacción y FK: el caso de fallo deja ambas ausentes y el caso exitoso conserva el vínculo exacto.
learning_outcomes.justification: Rollback works, but evidence is not linked to the exact decision and the gate is print-only.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Implementar upserts de entidad (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE) sin borrar historia de decisiones
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Implementar un current-state upsert sobre una clave de identidad explícita, impedir stale replay mediante condición de versión/frescura y conservar historial de entidad/decisiones por separado; resolver conflictos de unicidad idempotentemente en vez de reintentar cualquier IntegrityError.
learning_outcomes.justification: Current upsert uses wrong identity, overwrites newer state and conflicts with the roadmap history gate.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Versionar migraciones en schema_migrations, crear índices y evitar DROP sin backup
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Aplicar una migración ejecutable y versionada, registrar su revisión después del éxito, verificar índices con herramientas del motor y bloquear cambios destructivos cuando no exista un backup/restorable snapshot comprobado.
learning_outcomes.justification: Manual version row and slogan are not migration/backup evidence.

learning_outcomes.current_content: Encapsular SQL en un repository testeable con sqlite :memory: (pending, get, constraints)
learning_outcomes.improved_content: Encapsular SQL en un repository que preserve todas las constraints del modelo y ejecutar pytest sobre pending_review/get/append_decision y violaciones; complementar :memory: con archivo/reopen cuando el contrato sea persistencia o recovery.
learning_outcomes.justification: Canonical PairRepo drops constraints and is not actually tested.

theory_code_output.title: keys_constraints.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Add UNIQUE(entity_a,entity_b); explicit type/coercion cases; pytest.raises for FK/CHECK/duplicate; assert PRAGMA=1.
theory_code_output.justification: Runtime accepts duplicate canonical pair and coercible wrong types.

theory_code_output.title: temporality_prov.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use FK pair_id, controlled label domain, run_id, evidence_id FK, distinct/event timestamps/version; test update/delete policy and ordered history.
theory_code_output.justification: Current provenance fields are narrated rather than stored.

theory_code_output.title: cte_window_anti.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Derive latest state, filter pending first, then ROW_NUMBER ORDER BY score DESC,id; assert top pending on adversarial fixture with top resolved rows.
theory_code_output.justification: Current ordering of rank/filter loses pending cases.

theory_code_output.title: card_null_plan.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Keep COUNT/NULL examples, but print/assert EQP detail before/after index and explain Python None↔SQL NULL mapping separately from SQL semantics.

theory_code_output.title: acid_rollback.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Evidence references decisions(id); pytest failure injection asserts both counts zero; success case asserts exact FK lineage.
theory_code_output.justification: Atomic rollback is valid but relational linkage is absent.

theory_code_output.title: upsert_recover.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Use explicit source/natural conflict key or state-projection key, WHERE excluded.version > current.version, history table/event, and reopen test; classify UNIQUE duplicate separately from permanent IntegrityError.
theory_code_output.justification: Current demo permits stale overwrite and does not test recovery.

theory_code_output.title: indexes_migrate.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Execute a version-0→1 migration artifact, store applied metadata after success, verify index via PRAGMA/index detail, and add backup gate for destructive step.
theory_code_output.justification: Current schema is born already migrated and version row is self-asserted.

theory_code_output.title: repo_pool_tests.py
theory_code_output.improved_content: Create repository over canonical constrained schema; methods add_candidate/get_entity/append_decision/pending_review; collected pytest tests plus file-backed reopen case.
theory_code_output.justification: Final repository example weakens the schema and only prints one query.

callouts.title: Práctica observable
callouts.improved_content: Prints are learning diagnostics; critical claims also require pytest assertions/expected failures so CI exits non-zero when broken.
callouts.justification: Current wording implicitly treats printing real output as sufficient proof.

callouts.title: Orden canónico A<B
callouts.justification: Correctly limits canonical ordering to duplicate-candidate prevention and avoids behavioral inference.

callouts.title: UPDATE destruye historia
callouts.improved_content: Do not mutate historical decisions or membership events; mutable current-state projections may be upserted only when their version history is preserved separately.
callouts.justification: Current exception for entity upsert conflicts with roadmap history scope.

callouts.title: NOT EXISTS
callouts.justification: Sound NULL-safe anti-join guidance; the defect is workflow semantics, not NOT EXISTS itself.

callouts.title: NULL en join
callouts.justification: Correct for equality join and demonstrated fixture.

callouts.title: Misma transacción
callouts.improved_content: Same transaction plus FK to the exact decision version; atomicity alone cannot identify which evidence belongs to which decision.
callouts.justification: Current schema relates both by pair_id only.

callouts.title: Upsert ≠ borrar historia de decisiones
callouts.improved_content: Upsert only the declared current-state projection; preserve version history and reject stale replay. Decision history remains append-only separately.
callouts.justification: Current wording protects only decisions and ignores entity-history gate.

callouts.title: Índice no es magia
callouts.justification: Balanced read/write trade-off and measurement advice.

callouts.title: Repo testeable
callouts.improved_content: Inject connection, keep canonical constraints, assert repository outcomes with pytest, and use a file-backed DB/reopen test when persistence is part of the contract.
callouts.justification: Callout asks for asserts but canonical code does not supply them.

figures.improved_content: Show source record → versioned membership proposal/accepted link → entity, with state/validity/history; do not imply FK forces overwrite or that unlinking deletes history.
figures.justification: Current caption encodes the central modeling misconception.
Correct distinction: aggregate grouping collapses rows whereas window computation can retain them.

figures.improved_content: Caption should say the plan is a tree whose entries/nesting are interpreted according to SQLite's EQP output; first scan is outer loop and later nested scans are inner loops in the documented examples.
figures.justification: Universal bottom-up reading rule is inaccurate.
